headline: Who Turned ₹1 Lakh into ₹35 Lakh! Now the Company Will Set Up Business Abroad, Announces Purchase of Omnia for ₹12,951 Crore
summary: Solar Industries India is set to acquire South Africa's Omnia Holdings for about ₹12,951 crore ($1.355 billion). The deal is described as a major step in the company's global expansion.
why: Solar Industries India is a Nagpur-based explosives and defence products maker. Cross-border acquisitions like this affect its growth profile and balance sheet.
